author: vyasa
text_original: विष्वक्स्फुरन्तं ग्रहणातुरं हरिर्व्यालो यथाखुं कुलिशाक्षतत्वचम् । द्वार्यूरुमापत्य ददार लीलया नखैर्यथाहिं गरुडो महाविषम् ॥
text_iast: viṣvak sphurantaṃ grahaṇāturaṃ harir vyālo yathākhuṃ kuliśākṣatatvacam / dvāryūrumāpatya dadāra līlayā nakhairyathāhiṃ garuḍo mahāviṣam
verification_source: Wisdomlib Sanskrit witness of Śrīmad Bhāgavata 7.8.29 (Gita Press-listed Sanskrit edition), https://www.wisdomlib.org/hinduism/book/bhagavata-purana-sanskrit/d/doc1246232.html
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment; verification witness used for text comparison only.

author: vyasa
text_original: श्रीसिद्धा ऊचुः । यो नो गतिं योगसिद्धामसाधुरहार्षीद्योगतपोबलेन । नाना दर्पं तं नखैर्विददार तस्मै तुभ्यं प्रणताः स्मो नृसिंह ॥
text_iast: śrīsiddhā ūcuḥ / yo no gatiṃ yogasiddhāmasādhur ahārṣīdyogatapobalena / nānā darpaṃ taṃ nakhairvidadāra tasmai tubhyaṃ praṇatāḥ smo nṛsiṃha
verification_source: Wisdomlib Sanskrit witness of Śrīmad Bhāgavata 7.8.45 (Gita Press-listed Sanskrit edition), https://www.wisdomlib.org/hinduism/book/bhagavata-purana-sanskrit/d/doc1246248.html
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment; verification witness used for text comparison only.

author: vyasa
text_original: श्रीप्रजापतय ऊचुः । प्रजेशा वयं ते परेशाभिसृष्टा न येन प्रजा वै सृजामो निषिद्धाः । स एष त्वया भिन्नवक्षा नु शेते जगन्मङ्गलं सत्त्वमूर्तेऽवतारः ॥
text_iast: śrīprajāpataya ūcuḥ / prajeśā vayaṃ te pareśābhisṛṣṭā na yena prajā vai sṛjāmo niṣiddhāḥ / sa eṣa tvayā bhinnavakṣā nu śete jaganmaṅgalaṃ sattvamūrte 'vatāraḥ
verification_source: Wisdomlib Sanskrit witness of Śrīmad Bhāgavata 7.8.49 (Gita Press-listed Sanskrit edition), https://www.wisdomlib.org/hinduism/book/bhagavata-purana-sanskrit/d/doc1246252.html
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment; verification witness used for text comparison only.
